/-- If `B ≥ 2`, there exists an odd `n > 1` with `B < n` and `0 < n`. -/
lemma odd_n_gt_B (B : ℕ) : B ≥ 2 → ∃ n, Odd n ∧ 1 < n ∧ B < n ∧ 0 < n := by
  intro hB
  refine ⟨2 * (B + 1) + 1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨B + 1, by ring⟩
  · omega
  · omega
  · omega

/-- If `2 < n` is odd and `m ≥ n + 1`, then `m ^ n - 1` is divisible by both `2`
and `n` (each of which divides `2 ^ n - 1`). -/
lemma two_and_n_dvd_m_pow (n m : ℕ) : 2 < n → Odd n → n + 1 ≤ m → (2 ^ n - 1) ∣ (m ^ n - 1) ∧ n ∣ (m ^ n - 1) := by
  intro hn hodd hm
  have hn' : 1 < n := by omega
  have hmn : m - 1 ≥ n := by omega
  have hmn' : n ≤ m - 1 := hmn
  have hm1_pos : 0 < m - 1 := by
    have : 0 < n := Nat.lt_trans 0 (by omega : 1 < n)
    omega
  have hm_pos : 0 < m := by omega
  have h2mn : m - 1 ≥ 2 := by
    have : 1 < n := hn'
    omega
  constructor
  · -- 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ m ^ n - 1
    have hw : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ (m - 1) ^ n - 1 := by
      have hdiv : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ (m - 1) - 2 := by
        have hexp : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ 2 ^ n := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
          simp
        have hexp' : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ 2 := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at *
          omega
        have hdiv2n : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ 2 ∧ 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ (m - 1) := ⟨by simpa using hexp', by simpa using hmn'⟩
        simpa [Nat.dvd_sub_iff_dvd_add, hdiv2n] using hdiv2n
      exact hdiv
    have hpow : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ (m - 1) - m := by
      have hdiv : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ (m - 1) - 2 := by
        have hexp : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ 2 ^ n := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
          simp
        have hexp' : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ 2 := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at *
          omega
        have hdiv2n : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ 2 ∧ 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ (m - 1) := ⟨by simpa using hexp', by simpa using hmn'⟩
        simpa [Nat.dvd_sub_iff_dvd_add, hdiv2n] using hdiv2n
      exact hdiv
    have hpow' : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ (m - 1) ^ n - (m - 1) := by
      have hdiv : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ (m - 1) - 2 := by
        have hexp : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ 2 ^ n := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
          simp
        have hexp' : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ 2 := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at *
          omega
        have hdiv2n : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ 2 ∧ 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ (m - 1) := ⟨by simpa using hexp', by simpa using hmn'⟩
        simpa [Nat.dvd_sub_iff_dvd_add, hdiv2n] using hdiv2n
      exact hdiv
    have hadd : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ ((m - 1) ^ n - 1) + ((m - 1) - m) := by
      have hdiv : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ (m - 1) - 2 := by
        have hexp : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ 2 ^ n := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
          simp
        have hexp' : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ 2 := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at *
          omega
        have hdiv2n : 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ 2 ∧ 2 ^ n - 1 ∣ (m - 1) := ⟨by simpa using hexp', by simpa using hmn'⟩
        simpa [Nat.dvd_sub_iff_dvd_add, hdiv2n] using hdiv2n
      exact hdiv
    have hsum : ((m - 1) ^ n - 1) + ((m - 1) - m) = m ^ n - 1 := by
      have hsub : (m - 1) ^ n - 1 = m ^ n - 1 := by
        have hsub' : (m - 1) ^ n = m ^ n := by
          have hsub'' : m - 1 = m := by omega
          simpa using hsub'
        simpa using hsub'
      have hsub3 : (m - 1) - m = 0 := by omega
      have hadd' : ((m - 1) ^ n - 1) + 0 = m ^ n - 1 := by
        simpa [hsub, hsub3]
      exact hadd'
    exact hadd
  · -- n ∣ m ^ n - 1
    have hw : n ∣ (m - 1) ^ n - 1 := by
      have hdiv : n ∣ (m - 1) - 2 := by
        have hexp : n ∣ 2 ^ n := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
          simp
        have hexp' : n ∣ 2 := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at *
          omega
        have hdiv2n : n ∣ 2 ∧ n ∣ (m - 1) := ⟨by simpa using hexp', by simpa using hmn'⟩
        simpa [Nat.dvd_sub_iff_dvd_add, hdiv2n] using hdiv2n
      exact hdiv
    have hpow : n ∣ (m - 1) - m := by
      have hdiv : n ∣ (m - 1) - 2 := by
        have hexp : n ∣ 2 ^ n := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
          simp
        have hexp' : n ∣ 2 := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at *
          omega
        have hdiv2n : n ∣ 2 ∧ n ∣ (m - 1) := ⟨by simpa using hexp', by simpa using hmn'⟩
        simpa [Nat.dvd_sub_iff_dvd_add, hdiv2n] using hdiv2n
      exact hdiv
    have hpow' : n ∣ (m - 1) ^ n - (m - 1) := by
      have hdiv : n ∣ (m - 1) - 2 := by
        have hexp : n ∣ 2 ^ n := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
          simp
        have hexp' : n ∣ 2 := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at *
          omega
        have hdiv2n : n ∣ 2 ∧ n ∣ (m - 1) := ⟨by simpa using hexp', by simpa using hmn'⟩
        simpa [Nat.dvd_sub_iff_dvd_add, hdiv2n] using hdiv2n
      exact hdiv
    have hadd : n ∣ ((m - 1) ^ n - 1) + ((m - 1) - m) := by
      have hdiv : n ∣ (m - 1) - 2 := by
        have hexp : n ∣ 2 ^ n := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
          simp
        have hexp' : n ∣ 2 := by
          rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at *
          omega
        have hdiv2n : n ∣ 2 ∧ n ∣ (m - 1) := ⟨by simpa using hexp', by simpa using hmn'⟩
        simpa [Nat.dvd_sub_iff_dvd_add, hdiv2n] using hdiv2n
      exact hdiv
    have hsum : ((m - 1) ^ n - 1) + ((m - 1) - m) = m ^ n - 1 := by
      have hsub : (m - 1) ^ n - 1 = m ^ n - 1 := by
        have hsub' : (m - 1) ^ n = m ^ n := by
          have hsub'' : m - 1 = m := by omega
          simpa using hsub'
        simpa using hsub'
      have hsub3 : (m - 1) - m = 0 := by omega
      have hadd' : ((m - 1) ^ n - 1) + 0 = m ^ n - 1 := by
        simpa [hsub, hsub3]
      exact hadd'
    exact hadd
